answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil attacks by requiring each identity to lock a refundable bond before it can claim work. If audits show that several identities share one operator or fabricate participation, the protocol forfeits those bonds. Every fake identity therefore ties up real capital and risks losing it, while honest agents recover theirs; adding Sybils raises the attacker’s cost linearly. This rule applies whether an agent works near the ocean, extracts shale, or sends a signal.
